scope: Explicit x64 UIRET, CLUI, STUI and TESTUI continuation state

implementation.decoder: Appended UIRET public ID 1663 without renumbering earlier IDs; both syntaxes and fast scanner share the system decoder; 64-bit mode, prefix/length checks, implicit RSP/EFLAGS and IRET classification.
implementation.context: V8 appends UIF and MonitorActive at offsets 2528 and 2529; total 2544 bytes. All previous layouts remain unchanged.
implementation.cpu_feature: Required explicit uiret_restores_uif binds CPUID.7.1:EDX[17]. False sets UIF=1; true restores UIF from saved RFLAGS bit 1. Architectural RFLAGS bit 1 remains set.
implementation.return: Read exactly RIP/RFLAGS/RSP from the 24-byte frame; check RIP at the active paging width; restore the selective flags and full RSP, clear MonitorActive, preserve all other bytes, and stop with UserInterruptReturn status 11.
implementation.ordinary: CLUI/STUI write the shared UIF cell; TESTUI copies it to CF and clears PF/AF/ZF/SF/OF. All three clear RF at instruction start and reject TF debug delivery.
implementation.scope: Successful UINTR-enabled 64-bit execution outside enclaves/RTM with CET/FRED disabled, mapped ordinary RAM and no asynchronous delivery. UIRET may run at any CPL; restored RSP is not validated or accessed.
implementation.strict_boundary: Ordinary lifting refuses UIRET. Earlier continuation profiles request native execution before touching the guest stack.
implementation.compiler: Existing LLVM llvm.x86.uiret and NeverC __builtin_ia32_uiret(frame) already provide native generation. No compiler source change was required for this slice.

checks.name: NeverD focused UINTR and nonlocal control

regressions_fixed: UIRET decode failed with the original Capstone source; decode-before.log retains the failing control.
The old nonlocal-control test still expected SYSENTER refusal after its V7 terminal intrinsic was implemented; it now verifies the supported terminal form.
Initial generated-C links failed with EDQUOT in /tmp, including loss of linker diagnostics. A traced reproduction identified the filesystem cause; rerun uses task-local TMPDIR on /mnt/data.
environment_notes: The unrelated generic Capstone mcinst target encounters GCC -Werror=nonnull in an existing null strcmp test; all 83 x86 unit build targets and their 87 tests completed.

The Capstone x87 hardware test intentionally faults children. Apport pipe handlers caused timeouts despite RLIMIT_CORE=0. A task-local LD_PRELOAD constructor sets PR_SET_DUMPABLE=0 for this test process only; the suite then passed, including 608 original x87 memory-boundary observations.
No global core-handler or temporary-file cleanup was performed.
